_readme: Colour theme. Glyphs/units/tiles = theme_svg.py split of drawing_catalogue.svg (findings/t1-split, re-split 2026-10-06 22:03: area tiles redrawn sparser again (r6); 21:37: the water-flow line piece dropped). Colours = the dominant non-white fill (or stroke) of each Illustrator group; near-black artwork -> #000000; recomputed only for new/changed pieces. Sizes: every line unit and area tile uses 0.05 m per drawing unit (decoration scale 2 = 2/40; tile zoom 0.05), so the drawing's own proportions hold and the overhang triangle matches cSurvey's stock one. Spacing/density are first guesses until T7 harvests tuned values. Schema: ../README.md
name: Boja

signs._rotate: Glyphs are drawn as they look at TopoDroid orientation 0 (arrows pointing up). theme_apply.py undoes the +90 cSurvey's importer adds to air-draught and water-flow points by itself, so no rotate is needed (run r3, 2026-10-07; confirmed by the user, r6).

vegetable-debris._note: fills only, no outline pen: its stroke-only hairlines do not print; kept as is (user, r6)

lines._spacing: spacing_pct is cSurvey's raw decorationspacepercentage. On a spline (every imported line after KORAK 2) the pitch is 0.01 x unit width x (1 + spacing/10) per 0.01 m of path: 990 butts the units on horizontal/vertical runs, 3000 (cSurvey's own) leaves about two unit widths of gap. README 'Line decorations'.

ceiling-step._note: a row of inverted T's (user, r7): base stroke off like floor-meander; the unit lines/ceiling-step@T.svg is the r6 tick with a bar 2.5x its height along its foot, so every dash carries its own tick. outer: the bar sits on the line and the stem points to the other side than pit's (user r6). Scale 1.5 (bar 0.48 m, stem 0.19 m = pit's tick; 2 gave a 0.64 m bar and only 2 T's on the mockup's 3 m line), spacing 1400: gaps of 0.5-0.7 bar lengths (1200/1280 under 0.5, 1500 fewer T's; r7 print). r9: gaps too far on curves (user): 1400 -> 1100

floor-meander._note: double-line meander: base stroke off, the unit is both rails, centred and butted (brief 2.4)

overhang._note: denser than cSurvey's 3000: pitch about 0.25 m for the 0.14 m triangle, a gap of about 0.8 widths (user, r5)

slope._note: scale 0.8, not 2: the drawn arrow is 4x the triangles; 0.8 gives cSurvey's own 0.4 m slope arrow (r3 print)

slope:sheer._note: on the line like abyss-entrance (inner + flipped; auto would centre it like slope); gaps about double the stock 3000 (user, r4)

slope:steep._note: identical to slope:sheer: its artwork, side, scale and spacing (user, r5); lines/slope@steep.svg stays in the folder unused

water-flow._note: the drawn unit is one dash (28 x 1.07 units): read as a dash pattern of that thickness; dash 6/3 since r4 (the user wanted >= 4 gaps per sample segment, not 1) - a pen dash follows curves, a 1.4 m decoration chord would not (brief 2.4 'Dashes are a pen setting')

wall:presumed._note: the same thickness as wall (user, r9): stock pen 8 prints at about 2.3x wall; width 5 measured equal to wall on the print (3 was thinner), custom dash keeps the stock dash and gap lengths

areas._density: density = grid step in m, one tile per cell, randomly turned and shifted (cBrush.pRenderClipart). r6 (22:03 redraw, sparser tiles; user: r5 too dense): steps relaxed to about cSurvey's own coverage (izvorno column), checked over 4 seeds on the r6 mockup; blocks stays uneven on some seeds (a 2.9 x 1.5 m tile turned at random).

blocks._note: stroke-only art, outlined into fills by the split; crop none: a stone cut at the edge stays whole-outlined

stalagmite._note: marks stay upright as drawn (user, r4)

water._note: cSurvey's own water look in the water-flow sign blue: parallel lines at 45 degrees (brief 3.8, user r6); density = line spacing in m (basepatterns.xml Lines: Painter.Density = density x zoom), 0.33 = 3x cSurvey's 1 (user, r4). crno-bijelo inherits it and monochrome makes it black
